reviews.text:
The Hilton Lima is truly one of the nicest and friendliest hotels I’ve ever stayed at. From the moment I arrived, I felt so genuinely welcomed by the entire team.

Mario from concierge deserves special mention—he was amazing. Traveling alone as a young woman, I had a lot of anxiety about visiting Lima, but Mario was so professional, calming, and thoughtful. He took the time to recommend safe, interesting things to do in the city, and his care made me feel at ease and excited to explore instead of nervous. That kind of kindness stays with you.

The food and drinks were another highlight. The restaurant serves meals so good that even locals come to dine here, giving it the feeling of a beloved neighborhood favorite rather than just a hotel bar. Giancarlo was fantastic—super professional and dedicated to making every cocktail as perfect as possible. Jonathan, another bartender, also went out of his way to make the experience fun and memorable.

This hotel doesn’t just offer a place to stay—it creates an atmosphere of warmth and comfort that makes you feel both safe and celebrated. I can’t recommend it enough, and I’m grateful to the staff who turned my stay in Lima into something unforgettable.
Just know when im in lima again which i definitely will be I will always stay at the Hilton Lima Miraflores!!!
